ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Unsigned Thor Scanner Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects loading and execution of an unsigned thor scanner binary. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded, Signed, SignatureStatus, Signature

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\thor\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\thor64\\\.exe$")) AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\thor\\\.exe$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\thor64\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((Signed = "true" AND SignatureStatus = "valid" AND Signature = "Nextron\ Systems\ GmbH"))
